# Lethal Baboon

**Enter a facility where survival isn’t guaranteed… and silence is your only ally.**

Lethal Baboon is a fast-paced VR horror experience built around immersive gorilla-style locomotion. Move with your hands, climb, leap, and scramble through a dark, hostile facility overrun by unpredictable monsters.

**You’re not alone—but you’ll wish you were.**

Every sound you make could be your last. Hide in the shadows, navigate tight corridors, and outmaneuver creatures that are always hunting. They adapt, they listen, and they don’t forget.

**But you’re not completely helpless.**

Scattered throughout the facility are powerful mods that enhance your abilities—giving you a fighting chance. Upgrade your movement, unlock tools, and push back against the horrors lurking in the dark… if you’re brave enough.

**Key Features:**

🦍 Gorilla Locomotion Movement – Fully physics-based VR traversal for intense, immersive gameplay
👁️ Stealth Horror Gameplay – Hide, evade, and survive against relentless monsters
⚙️ Upgradeable Mods – Discover and equip enhancements to fight back
🏢 Dynamic Facility Environment – Explore a maze of rooms, vents, and hidden paths
🔊 Sound Matters – Your movement and actions can attract unwanted attention

In Lethal Baboon, every decision matters.

**Run. Hide. Fight. Or get caught.**
